method: Standalone Cargo executable linked against the actual local rrrah-dedup crate with default features disabled; public exact::scan_verified called four times on owned temporary files. No mock scanner or copied production module.

controls.hardlink_to_otherwise_unique_file: one alias set with two paths, no extra duplicate group

reproduction: inputs.json lists original pinned paths and hashes in stable order. Verify/download these to the documented flat cache; write their absolute cache paths, one per line, to a list; pass that list to this Cargo executable. Retained manifest adjusts only the dependency/source locations for this evidence directory.
limits: Mac ARM host only; public exact-file behavior, not visual matching, all-feature suite, native pHash/ASAN, platform matrix or performance qualification.
Image resources are opaque bytes to this exact-file probe. Different resolutions and formats are not asserted to be visual negatives.
No user files modified; fixtures owned and removed by tempfile. No production implementation change.
